[[Ardeh's Daggers]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] dropped by [[Ardeh the Quick]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Joko's Domain]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] 20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Ancient Daggers (rare)]] [[dye]]d white.
